name: generative-scorer-format-fragility

origin.produced_by: A02 read-tax gate (commit 3c9f8f9) + A02 misorder gate (this one)
origin.why_not_owned_by_A02: separable: the claim concerns any base LM scored by babilong.metrics on a generative task, with or without CoMem or a depth knob. A02 retains provenance and the source generations, not ownership.
origin.why_not_owned_by_B04: B04's construct is per-item acc_norm decision-margin compression under model damage -- a likelihood-ranking metric over MC options, no generation, no retrieval, no string matching, status NARROWED_TO_OLMO_2_ONLY. This is a generative string-matching scorer's TEXT PREPROCESSING interacting with output format. Same umbrella word 'eval fragility', different measured construct, different mechanism, different failure surface. Merging would let the OLMo-2-only margin claim borrow support from an unrelated mechanism.

claim: A generative long-context benchmark scorer's text preprocessing can encode output-format conventions strongly enough to destroy the RANKING of a true effect of +70 to +84 pp, and the failure localises to specific auditable lines of the metric.

established_measurements.inversion_significance: NOT significant: best exact McNemar p = 0.0703 on 8 discordant items (b=1,c=7); Holm-adjusted within the 6-cell family = 0.4219
established_measurements.claim_strength: RANKING FAILURE, not demonstrated sign error
established_measurements.one_operation_ablation: removing ONLY preprocess_output's first-period truncation (uniqueness requirement retained, so multiple-choice lists still score 0 and chance inflation is removed by construction) repairs the inversion on 2 of 6 cells and makes qa1x32k a perfect ladder rho=-1.000 p=0.0167; qa2 is unrepairable (floor, A4=1%)
established_measurements.cell_level_dissociation: the 4 inverting cells are EXACTLY the 4 high-list-format cells; [[4,0],[0,2]], Fisher exact p=0.0667 = the minimum attainable with 6 cells, so DESCRIPTIVE dissociation, not a powered test

refuted_hypotheses.retrieval_domination: REFUTED as the mechanism for the inversion. Conditioning on the arm-independent retrieval HIT/MISS label, the inversion is LARGER on HIT (qa1x16k HIT -6.67 vs MISS +8.57; qa2x32k -13.64 vs -5.41). Low recall@12 (22.9-63.2%) remains the correct reason these cells cannot support depth inference IN GENERAL, but it does not explain the inversion.
refuted_hypotheses.retracted_intermediate_number: a lenient format-insensitive read (target_in_raw) showed 4/6 sign flips, but it is chance-inflated for multiple-choice outputs and A4 emits lists far more often. The strict ablation gives 2/6. 2/6 is the number that stands.

not_identified: retrieval vs floor cannot be separated across 6 cells: Spearman(A0_acc, signed_sep) = +0.943 exact p=0.0167 (n=6 lower bound) but Spearman(recall, A0_acc) = +0.714, i.e. substantially collinear. Floor has the better sign, p and story, but the mechanism is NOT IDENTIFIED and must not be claimed.

kill_gates.test: check answer-extraction / metric-robustness literature: lm-evaluation-harness answer extraction, exact_match variants, MCQ answer-parsing robustness, LLM-as-judge vs string match. Venue rules: OpenReview venueid for ICLR/NeurIPS/ICML; aclanthology+DBLP for the ACL family incl. Findings.
kill_gates.kill_if: the literature already covers 'preprocessing truncation changes model ranking'

kill_gates.test: a second model family; output-format habit is a family property
kill_gates.kill_if: no arm-wise list-format asymmetry in the second family AND the inversion disappears -> degrades to 'Qwen3 format habit + one scorer bug', archive as an A02 appendix negative result

kill_gates.test: do LongBench / RULER / LongEval scorers have the same class of preprocessing?
kill_gates.kill_if: no other generative long-context scorer does -> downgrade to an upstream bug report

forbidden_claims: 'BABILong inverts conclusions' -- the inversion is NOT significant (p=0.0703, Holm 0.4219)
retrieval is the mechanism -- refuted, inversion is larger on HIT
attributing to retrieval OR floor separately -- collinear across 6 cells, not identified
the 4/6 figure from target_in_raw -- chance-inflated, superseded by 2/6
merging with B04 -- different construct and mechanism
gpu_policy: NO GPU until K1 (novelty, 0 GPU) passes.
